cause: The facet entity store compares written display names with NFKC, Python-compatible whitespace collapse, and full Unicode case folding, while the legacy Python attach path compares lowercased strings and derives lookup placement from slugs.

entries.reason: Full case folding makes Straße Handel equal STRASSE HANDEL without consulting a slug-derived identity.
NFKC expands the fi ligature before name comparison, while Python lower leaves the ligature distinct.
Python-compatible whitespace collapse treats U+001C as a separator, while Python lower does not equate the two names.

note: The reference outcome was captured from the Python attach operation against the same opaque written-id journal fixture; the native outcome is executed by facet_entity_fixture_tests.
